content.text:
Finding submitted: **compliant** (preferred position).

§ 24 already delivers the full preferred bargain — Customer's consent-free affiliate/successor assignment with notice (24.1), a consent gate on Vendor assignment, delegation and change-of-control transfer with a reasonableness standard plus a competitor bar (24.2), a mutual reasonable-consent standard for other assignments (24.3), and an express denial of any Vendor termination, suspension or repricing right on Customer's change of control (24.4). No redline proposed; the only gap (the competitor bar being consent-qualified rather than absolute) is a minor sub-element noted in the rationale.
